title: Duties of the Doctor: *köteles*, *nem teheti ki*
grammar: What a doctor must and must not do
goal: I can say what a doctor or a hospital is obliged to do with *köteles* and *kell*.
I can say what a doctor must not do with *nem teheti ki* and *nem hallgathatja el*.
I can name the ideas of medical ethics (*betegbiztonság*, *orvosi eskü*, *tájékozott beleegyezés*).
